segments.name: Intelligent Devices
segments.description: Builds drives, motion, safety, sensing and other industrial components and configured-to-order products for automation customers.
segments.evidence: The Intelligent Devices segment includes drives, motion, advanced material handling, safety, sensing, industrial components, and configured-to-order products.

segments.name: Software & Control
products: control and visualization software and hardware
segments.description: Supplies control and visualization software and hardware, digital twin and simulation software, and network and security infrastructure.
segments.evidence: The Software & Control segment includes control and visualization software and hardware, digital twin, simulation and information software, and network and security infrastructure.

segments.name: Lifecycle Services
segments.description: Provides consulting, engineered-to-order and recurring services such as cybersecurity, remote monitoring and asset management for industrial customers.
segments.evidence: The Lifecycle Services segment includes digital consulting, professional services including engineered-to-order solutions, recurring services including cybersecurity, safety, remote monitoring, and asset management, and the Sensia joint venture.

revenueModel.text: Industrial manufacturers and process companies pay Rockwell Automation for automation hardware, software and lifecycle services.
revenueModel.evidence: Major markets served by all segments consist of discrete end markets (e.g., Automotive including Electric Vehicle and Battery, Semiconductor, and e-Commerce & Warehouse Automation)
